subject: Rename redisAtomic to serverAtomic (#180)
reason: The change is a mechanical identifier rename: the redisAtomic macro becomes serverAtomic, with the same expansion (#define serverAtomic / #define serverAtomic _Atomic) and every declaration site renamed in lockstep. No behaviour, reply, data format, or concurrency semantics change; an incomplete rename would be a compile-time error, not a runtime bug, so there is nothing for a scenario to exercise.
